answer: A concrete rule the ledger can enforce: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because quartz only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, voyage is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any cipher approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
